title: Tropical/Paradise
content: Apply tropical paradise aesthetic with vacation vibes. Vibrant colors: turquoise, coral, golden yellow, lush green. Palm tree and tropical leaf motifs. Sunset gradient backgrounds. Include tropical flowers: hibiscus, plumeria. Beach and ocean imagery. Relaxed, curved typography. Bamboo and rattan texture accents. Fun, energetic summer atmosphere. Island resort aesthetic.

variants.simple: Create vibrant tropical theme with palm trees, exotic colors, and beach vacation atmosphere.
variants.detailed: Apply tropical paradise aesthetic with vacation vibes. Vibrant colors: turquoise, coral, golden yellow, lush green. Palm tree and tropical leaf motifs. Sunset gradient backgrounds. Include tropical flowers: hibiscus, plumeria. Beach and ocean imagery. Relaxed, curved typography. Bamboo and rattan texture accents. Fun, energetic summer atmosphere. Island resort aesthetic.
variants.advanced: Apply tropical paradise aesthetic with vibrant vacation energy. Color palette: ocean turquoise (#00bcd4, cyan-500), coral (#ff7f50, pink-400), golden sun yellow (#ffc107), palm green (#4caf50), sunset orange (#ff5722). Gradient skies: sunset gradients (yellow to orange to pink to purple) for backgrounds. Tropical foliage: palm fronds, monstera leaves, banana leaves as decorative elements (SVG), can frame content. Flowers: hibiscus, plumeria, bird of paradise as accents. Water effects: wave patterns, ocean texture, swimming pool ripples. Typography: relaxed, playful fonts (Pacifico, Lobster for display, Nunito for body), slightly bouncy feel. Textures: bamboo/rattan patterns for accents, woven texture, driftwood. Beach elements: sand texture, seashells, surfboards, tiki elements. Lighting: golden hour warmth, lens flare effects, bright and cheerful. Patterns: tropical print patterns (leaves, flowers) for backgrounds or accents. Interactive: gentle wave animations, swaying palm leaves, sun rays. Tiki option: carved wood textures, tribal patterns, torch flames. Resort option: clean pool-side aesthetic, cabana stripes. Photography: saturated, warm color grading, blue skies. Implementation: CSS gradients for skies, SVG for foliage patterns. Accessibility: vibrant colors need contrast attention, maintain readability.
